decisions.reason: As a flagship organic line with several variants that fits the firm's stated expansion into organic products, it is very likely to be retained.
This organic convenience snack stays close to the firm's core charcuterie business and supports its ingredient-conscious growth direction, so keeping it is more likely than dropping it.
A premium sharing salami line broadens the assortment within the firm's established strengths and was actively presented on its own page, which points to continuation.
